t: The Parthian Empire was an Iranian power founded by the Arsacids that ruled from the Euphrates to the Iranian plateau.
Its cavalry held Rome at the Euphrates for centuries, and it profited as the Silk Road link between Rome and Han China.
Noble rivalry, civil wars and Roman captures of Ctesiphon weakened it; Ardashir I's Sasanians ended Arsacid rule in 224 CE.
dyk: At Carrhae in 53 BCE, the Parthian general Surena kept his horse archers supplied from a camel train of arrows, destroying a Roman army under Crassus.
ev: Arsaces I of the Parni seizes the satrapy of Parthia from Andragoras
Mithridates I conquers the Seleucid heartland of Mesopotamia
Surena's Parthian army destroys the Roman army of Crassus at Carrhae
Mark Antony's invasion ends in a costly Roman retreat
Trajan captures the Parthian capital, Ctesiphon
Ardashir I kills Artabanus IV at Hormozdgan, founding the Sasanian Empire
